subject: Discovery recap + request to schedule dedicated sizing call
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@lumenpay.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@lumenpay.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + request to schedule dedicated sizing call

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the detailed overview of how LumenPay wants to route transaction descriptions and webhook enrichment through an LLM. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical sizing session: 

Summary (from our notes)
- Primary workload: webhook enrichment + classification (fraud tags, merchant normalization).
- Expected steady-state: ~120 requests/sec at peak bursts up to ~240 req/sec for short windows (~1–2 min).
- Typical input sequence length: ~512 tokens (includes context + examples); some requests spike to ~2k tokens for enriched history.
- P50 latency target: <= 80ms for user-facing enrichment; P95 target <= 300ms acceptable.
- Data residency & audit log requirements: retention of request+response logs for 90 days; redaction rules will be provided by Tom.

What we need for the next step
1) Book a 60-minute dedicated capacity sizing call (throughput + latency tuning + data retention).
2) Have an engineer or PM from your side who owns the payloads/traffic patterns on the call (suggest Tom + your infra lead).
3) Share a small sample of representative payloads (anonymized) and a simple RPS profile (CSV attached sample).

Proposed slots (PT) — pick one and I will send a calendar invite:
- Tue Feb 14 | 14:00–15:00 PT
- Wed Feb 15 | 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Feb 16 | 08:00–09:00 PT (earlier window)

I’ve attached a short sizing checklist and a lightweight form that helps our infra team pre-populate test scenarios. If you can fill that out before the call (5–7 minutes) we can validate throughput assumptions faster.

Attachments: redwood-sizing-checklist.pdf (checklist), discovery-notes.csv (redacted sample schema)

Thanks — I’ll loop in Rishi for the throughput/latency calibration and Monica for PO/discovery-to-contract handoff.

—
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122
https://redwood.ai

Thanks, Olga — great summary and helpful checklist. Tom and I reviewed and the team can do Wed Feb 15 10:00–11:00 PT or Tue Feb 14 14:00–15:00 PT; Wed morning is slightly preferred.

A few quick notes to help the sizing discussion:
- Our steady peak today is ~120 req/s, but Black Friday-like events can push short bursts up to ~240 req/s for 3–5 minutes.
- Average input size ~512 tokens; 99th percentile of inputs from merchant history ~1.8k tokens.
- We’d like to aim for p50 generation latency under 80ms and p95 under 300ms as you noted — that’s our product target for enrichment flows.
- Security/compliance: we’ll include our platform security lead (cc’d below on the invite once we lock a time).

I uploaded a short CSV with anonymized request counts + payload-size histogram: lumenpay-traffic-sample.csv (attached). Also linking our internal perf notes: https://lumenpay.atlassian.net/lumenpay/perf-2027 (internal)

Emily Park
Head of Integrations | LumenPay
emily@lumenpay.com
